description: The sports cappers who are up the most units, ranked, with each one's record, units and page, tracked from their public posts on X (Twitter). Use it when someone asks which cappers are winning, who leads a league or who is hot right now. Takes an optional league (NBA, NFL, college football, NHL) and a window of 30 or 7 days. Only cappers who are up over the window are named.

sport.description: A league, like "NBA", "NFL", "NCAAF" or "NHL". Leave out for every league.

window_days.description: The window in days. 30 when left out.
